policy: Source, settings, protocols and complete score summaries for unsuccessful experiments; detailed results for leaders, scored artifacts and useful matched controls.
scope: 31 existing tracked experiment families under part1/experiments. Existing LDA/New Directions archives and additional untracked working experiments are untouched.
discarded_file_inventory: Not retained. Aggregate counts are recorded per study. The baseline commit identifies historical files.
reproduction: Current grouped leader verification/replay wrappers remain supported. Older notebooks may need upstream datasets/models regenerated in a disposable checkout; historical hash records describe the original runs, not current retained storage.
